name: The Fortress Gates
subtitle: The first assault on the seat of darkness

scenes.narration: The fortress materializes before them like a wound in the sky — black stone that seems to swallow light, towers that twist in ways that hurt to look at. It is not built. It is grown. Fed. Alive.
Aya stands at the front, the four Seal Fragments held in her hands. They pulse with light — answering each other, drawing closer to completion.

dialogue.speaker: Aya
dialogue.text: Four pieces broken and reclaimed. One fragment remains — inside that darkness. And one more answer: why.

dialogue.speaker: Tao
dialogue.text: I have guided the dead across the veil for so long. I can feel the weight of souls trapped in that place. Screaming.

dialogue.speaker: Rei
dialogue.text: Then we give them peace. We give them freedom. We tear down this monument to fear.

dialogue.speaker: Lulu
dialogue.text: Six of us. One darkness. The math is simple.

chapters.title: The Void Citadel
chapters.map_hint: Push through the Void Citadel — the Void Warden guards the fortress gate beyond.

pre_dialogue.speaker: narrator
pre_dialogue.text: The Void Citadel stretches before them — black stone that swallows light, towers that twist in ways that hurt to look at. Shadow-creatures pour from every passage, guardians of the outer ring.

pre_dialogue.speaker: Rei
pre_dialogue.text: Let them come. We break through.

pre_dialogue.speaker: Ria
pre_dialogue.text: The eidolons say this place was not always dark. Once, it held light. They remember singing in its halls.

pre_dialogue.speaker: Valka
pre_dialogue.text: Then we reclaim it. Not for ourselves — for what was stolen from it.

post_dialogue.speaker: narrator
post_dialogue.text: At the heart of the citadel, a figure coalesces from shadow — ancient, vast, wearing robes of starlight corrupted to ash. The Void Warden.

post_dialogue.speaker: narrator
post_dialogue.text: Void Warden: Valdris is pleased you reached this far. He did not think you would.

post_dialogue.speaker: Aya
post_dialogue.text: Then he has learned nothing about us.

pre_dialogue.speaker: narrator
pre_dialogue.text: The Void Warden solidifies fully — a creature of pure shadow, wielding authority over this realm.

pre_dialogue.speaker: Rei
pre_dialogue.text: It is not alive. It is purpose given form.

post_dialogue.speaker: narrator
post_dialogue.text: The Void Warden dissolves, its form unraveling like burning paper. The outer gates of the fortress groan, the dark energy holding them shut beginning to fracture.

post_dialogue.speaker: Lulu
post_dialogue.text: The gates are breaking. The fortress is... weakening. We can feel the light from the Fragments reaching inside.

post_dialogue.speaker: Aya
post_dialogue.text: Then we continue. We have breached the outer ring. The Shadow Emperor's inner sanctum lies just beyond these ramparts.

post_dialogue.speaker: Drake
post_dialogue.text: The air here is thick with his influence, but it is not absolute. We push forward. Together.
